nodes.asset_description: A central, cut-out photograph of a plastic cup filled with iced latte. The cup contains light caramel-colored coffee with visible swirling gradients, topped with ice cubes and a creamy foam layer. The cup is slightly translucent with condensation and a plastic lid edge visible around the rim; soft shadowing suggests front lighting.
